name: Mavericks 2: Resurrection of the Repliforce:
storyline: Two years after the first game, the Repliforce has also been restored and they're up to their old tricks of a Reploid-only nation, as well as a dish of revenge. It's up to X and Zero to save the day again, but with Iris among the restored, how far will Zero go to amend his biggest regret?
summary: A sequel to the first Mavericks game that takes place 2 years after it
